report.summary: Chunk 1 of 3: package init with MemoryEvent dataclass, append_event, projection_event_from_record, _try_vector_index stubs.
risks: ROOT | medium | Uses parents[2] to find repo root; fragile if file moves. | Verify with unit test.
MEMORY_DIR / EVENTS_PATH / TODO_PATH / VECTOR_DB_PATH | low | Paths hardcoded relative to ROOT; no validation of existence. | Ensure directories exist at startup.
append_event | low | DAEDALUS_VECTOR_INDEX env var checked; if set but Ollama not running, _try_vector_index may fail silently. | Confirm error handling inside _try_vector_index.
projection_event_from_record | medium | Returns AgentEvent but imports from .embeddings; if that module fails, runtime error. | Verify .embeddings module exists and is importable.
_try_vector_index | low | Docstring says 'never raises' but code not shown; could still raise. | Review implementation for exception handling.
todos: Implement _try_vector_index to actually index into vector store.
Ensure projection_worker module is created and functional.
Add validation for environment variable DAEDALUS_VECTOR_INDEX values.

claims.text: Operational state must remain in the repository-level memory/ directory; using parents[1] here silently redirected state into daedalus/memory/.
claims.why: Refers to historical issue with parents[1]; not verifiable from current code.

claims.text: This is the single definition of 'what a memory event embeds as', shared by the synchronous bridge below and by daedalus.memory.projection_worker.
claims.why: Cannot verify sharing with projection_worker module not in chunk.

claims.text: The index is content-addressed on a hash of exactly these fields, so two writers that derive an event differently would write two rows for one journal line instead of one.
claims.why: No hashing or content-addressing logic visible in this chunk.

claims.text: The context compiler may map a latent memory hit back into the Forest only when such evidence is present; semantic similarity alone must never invent a file.
claims.why: Refers to context compiler and Forest not present in this chunk.

claims.text: This bridge does NOT record a journal watermark -- it sees one record at a time and has no idea where that record sits in the journal file.
claims.why: Code shows append_event calls _try_vector_index with a single record, no watermark logic present.

claims.text: Indexes it builds alone therefore report freshness == 'unanchored'.
claims.why: No freshness reporting logic visible in this chunk.

claims.text: Run python -m daedalus.memory.projection_worker to anchor them; it costs no embedding calls for entries the bridge already projected.
claims.why: projection_worker module not present in this chunk.

observations.what: ROOT uses parents[2] which assumes __file__ is three levels deep in repo; if package structure changes, ROOT will be wrong.
MEMORY_DIR and related paths are hardcoded; no validation that they exist or are writable.
append_event calls refresh_todo_snapshot() but that function is not defined in this chunk; will cause NameError at runtime.
append_event conditionally calls _try_vector_index based on env var; function body not shown but docstring says 'never raises'.
projection_event_from_record imports AgentEvent inside function; if .embeddings module missing, runtime error.
projection_event_from_record constructs event_id from time and kind; if time not unique, IDs may collide.
